name: Black Beauty
description: The unmatched beauty of Africa needs no assistance. It’s clear to see the foundation of elegance and sophistication within this booklet’s gold tones and black background. This striking booklet will be the ideal way to share the happy memories and love that everyone in your circle shared.

name: Gemini Orange
description: The unmatched beauty of Africa needs no assistance. It’s clear to see the foundation of elegance and sophistication within this booklet’s gold tones and black background. This striking booklet will be the ideal way to share the happy memories and love that everyone in your circle shared.

name: Angel Wings
description: . Angels come in many forms, as you already know. So, those angels among us deserve something a bit more special for their service. This beautifully designed booklet shows the world the special angel that helped make your life what it is: Better!

name: Holy Feather
description: . Feathers are peaceful, pure and show the progression of life. If you find a feather, you’re lucky! Just as you are lucky to have your loved one in your life. The Holy Feather booklet will compliment the personality of any delicate soul that has blessed our lives.

name: Rose And Sleek
description: . This memories booklet is more masculine, still holding its sophistication and elegance. There is plenty of space for hymns, the order of service and a selection of photos.

name: Amber Rose
description: . The Amber Rose is sophisticated smart and ideal for ladies. It features an order of service, space for your hymns and also a photo gallery so your loved one’s memories can live forever.

name: Golden Ocean
description: . This booklet is striking, deep and full of character with its rich tones. Perfect for men with dashing personalities, you will be able to give them a send off that suits their exceptional character.

name: Acrylic Splashes
description: . This landscape booklet is quirky, artistic with lots going on. It’s truly unique design complements those with these mentioned qualities. Tell those around you how beautifully unique your loved one is.
photo_allowance: Option 1 – 12 gallery Photos Option 1 – 24 gallery Photos 2 Individual Photo

name: Floral Wreath
description: . Our Floral Wreath is stunningly beautiful, with soft pinks and blues. Naturally favoured for women, this will ensure your loved one gets a send off that is as beautiful as they are.

name: Cloudy Skies
description: . Artistic, pretty and strikingly elegant, this booklet provides enough space for several photos of memories, and to write the perfect send off for your loved one. Ideal for ladies

name: Domino Effect
description: . Dominoes is a fun game enjoyed by many gentlemen. This domino themed booklet shows the determination and strength of your loved one with its smart and sophisticated dark tones and clever design; with plenty of room to show happy memories and funny stories.

name: Honey Comb
description: . Our life stories are like a book, and with this design you get exactly that. This would be suitable for most people, but those that are having a smaller service. It still provides enough space to tell the story of your loved ones beautiful life.

name: Snow Flake
description: . This booklet has a stunning layout, using pastel greys and whites to bring the pages together. It has plenty of space for you to tell the story of life, and show this story with up to 23 photos.

name: Clear Satin
description: . With a blue paisley pattern in the background, this is suitable for men with class. It’s generous layout including up to 22 photos, allows you to tell the world how cherished your loved one is.

name: She Loves Flowers
description: . Ladies tend to love flowers, especially when they are as beautiful as these. Full of vibrancy and positive energy, this booklet will sing in tune perfectly with any ladies send off, giving those around them the same positive energy that will always be valued.

name: Godfather
description: . Strikingly sophisticated, and with a tone of professionalism, the Godfather booklet will be the perfect choice for any gentleman. A predominantly dark background can be complemented with your loved ones favourite colour to give the perfect balance of personality in your booklet.
photo_allowance: 4 Pager – 9 Photos 8 Pager – 25 Photos 12 Pager – 41 Photos 16 Pager – 57 Photos

name: White Lilies
description: . White means purity and innocence. Lilies symbolise purity too. This combination of beauty and purity is perfect for that special person who will continue to bring light and happiness into your lives for eternity. With plenty of space for your order of service and hymns, this is a great option.

name: Rose Petals
description: . Consider your loved ones send off in capable hands. The Memories Rose Petals Standard Funeral Booklet is the perfect choice and more importantly fits any budget like a glove.

name: Purple Rainforest
description: . With it’s beautiful floral design, butterflies and elegant fonts, this is just right for any lady of class. From sunrise to sunset, tell family and friends the story of a graceful life.

name: Rasta Theme
description: . The Rastafarian faith is full of love, compassion and understanding, which is perfect for any adherent. The bright and vibrant colours of the Rasta themed booklet will spread the love of Jah and your loved one throughout the ceremony.
photo_allowance: Option 1: 9 gallery Photos 2 Individual Photo Option 2: 4 Pager – 4 Photos 8 Pager – 16 Photos 12 Pager – 28 Photos

name: Signature
description: . The Signature booklet has been designed to accommodate your loved ones story with a classical feel. Its bold features make this the perfect way to make a statement, with class and sophistication.

name: Victorian Colours
description: . Consider your loved ones send off in capable hands. The Memories Victorian Colours Standard Funeral Booklet is the perfect choice and more importantly fits any budget like a glove.

name: Nigeria
description: . The stripes symbolise wealth and peace, which sounds like the perfect lifestyle. But that lifestyle doesn’t have to stop, so keep it going by using this stunning booklet for your loved ones send off. With space for your order of ceremony, stories and pictures, this is will make the day that little bit more perfect.

name: Barbados
description: . The symbol at the centre of the flag represents the Trident of the mythical sea god, Neptune. The blues and gold relate to the sky and golden beaches of Barbados. Beautiful paradise, which is the perfect accompanying theme for the perfect Barbados style send off.

name: Ghana
description: This booklet is striking, deep and full of character with its rich tones. Perfect for any passionate Ghanaian, you will be able to give them a send off that suits their exceptional character.

name: St. Lucia
description: Saint Lucia is paradise; sea and sky unite to create stunning blues. The flag is no different, highlighting the country’s true beauty. Your loved one is no different, their life and beauty should be remembered forever. This perfectly designed booklet is the ideal choice for any Sain Lucian.

name: Antigua
description: African ancestry, hope and energy fuse together in the flag of Antigua; which will surely compliment the personality of your loved one. Show your valued people the meaning of Antigua through this tasteful and elegant booklet.

name: Dominica
description: Liberty, salvation and blood of heroes; this is the meaning behind the flag of Dominica. This is the perfect booklet to send off your loved one as the valued hero that they are, strong, loved and never forgotten.

name: Trinidad
description: The Trinidadian flag represents independence, fire and earth; which makes it an ideal choice for both ladies and gentlemen. The heat and love will compliment the life story of your loved one, allowing that warmth to be felt by everyone for years to come.

name: Jamaica
description: Green, yellow and black create the unmissable identity of the Jamaican culture. Life, health and understanding will echo your loved ones personality and character beautifully, showing everyone their roots and values and the love of the Jamaican heritage.

name: Grenada
description: The colours of the Grenadian flag say life, vibrance and energy. So this booklet is the perfect way to celebrate the life of both men and women who share those same characteristics as the Grenada flag! Use the pages to tell the world the life story of your loved one.

name: Tottenham F.C.
description: Tottenham F.C Any Spurs fan will love this Tottenham themed send off. The clean cut design and pure white background will emphasise the love they have for their favouri te club. Solidarity and dedication shine through with this suave and stylish booklet.

name: Liverpool F.C.
description: This booklet is perfect for any Liverpool fan. Vibrant reds, bold designs and of course, the Liverpool club crest makes it look like your loved one was a part of the team! As they say; “You’ll never walk alone”, this booklet will ensure you have the right space to tell your loved ones journey through life.

name: Manchester City F.C.
description: Manchester City means light blue, which is such a powerful colour. This booklet compliments the clubs colour code, while your loved ones story is told alongside it. Ideal for any city fan, this will show the world their undying passion forever.

name: Manchester United F.C.
description: Big, bold and red! The loving and passionate energy or the colour red will shine through to show your attendees the passion and love that they have for their team. With a central club badge as the focal point, there is space for your order of ceremony, pictures and comments.

name: Chelsea
description: Blue Lions and Bentley Boys live forever. Chelsea fans will adore this themed booklet. Strong blues and complimenting fonts will encapsulate your loved ones passion for a brilliant London club.

name: Arsenal F.C.
description: Arsenal Passionate and loving like the colour red, this will symbolise your loved ones dedication to this fiery London football club. An ideal option for any Arsenal fan, this booklet has the space you need to show the world your loved ones passion, along with your order of ceremony and pictures to accompany.
